137958.overview: Inside Outing is an isometric arcade adventure game released by The Edge in 1988 for the ZX Spectrum, Amstrad CPC and Commodore 64. It was later also released for the Atari ST and Amiga with the title Raffles. Subsequent 8-bit reissues were also given this title. It was released in the U.S. by Epyx as Devon Aire in the Hidden Diamond Caper.

189804.overview: READ WITH Asterix! Enjoy, with picture and sound, another exciting adventure of Asterix, the small but valiant Gaulish warrior whose very name fills foes with fear.In this story Asterix, more comfortable thumping Romans than changing nappies, finds himself adopted by a very special baby. Find out how he copes! This disc brings you the complete Asterix adventure, with: over 400 drawings in full colour almost 60 minutes of listening, as the story unfolds through the voices of over 40 characters.
